title: Audit enrichment and human-flagging for suspicious proration adjustments
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Over the past quarter Finance has observed several proration adjustments generated by the billing export pipeline that required manual correction during invoice reconciliation. Root causes are mixed: late-arriving sub-minute meter pulses, overlapping commitment discounts, and coupon application timing that the exporter normalizes differently than Finances expectations. These adjustments occasionally produce negative flip lines or multi-line corrections that are not trivially traceable back to source meter events.

Goal: Add contextual audit enrichment to exported invoice lines and implement a human-review flagging path for anomalous proration adjustments so Finance and Customer Success can triage and approve corrections before NetSuite ingestion. This reduces time-to-resolve for disputed invoices and prevents downstream chargebacks.

Scope: Produce deterministic, enriched export records with granular attribution (origin meter IDs, event time windows, applied discount/coupon IDs, confidence score for proration computation). Implement anomaly detection heuristics that flag exports for human review (UI + CSV queue) and add a manual override workflow that emits an update to the reconciler when Finance approves a correction.
proposed_solution: 1) Enrich per-export line metadata: include origin_event_ids (comma-separated), meter_window_start/end iso timestamps, discount_ids, coupon_ids, computed_prorate_fraction (string numeric), and proration_confidence (high/medium/low). 2) Build a lightweight anomaly classifier in the reconciler: heuristics include negative total after discounts, >50% change from shadow export baseline, and multi-line intra-invoice offsets. 3) Persist flagged exports to a new audit queue (S3 CSV + DB index) and surface them to Finance UI (spreadsheet-friendly export with trace links). 4) Add an approvals API that allows Finance to mark a flagged export as approved/adjusted; reconciler will apply a deterministic correction and re-run NetSuite mapping. 5) Add end-to-end tests and a canary rollout to a small tenant cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Export records contain new audit fields: origin_event_ids, meter_window_start, meter_window_end, discount_ids, coupon_ids, computed_prorate_fraction, proration_confidence
Anomaly detector flags >95% of known historical adjustments (recall target) when run against 12w historical backfill
Flagged exports are written to audit queue and downloadable as CSV from the Finance tooling bucket
Finance can approve/adjust a flagged export via approvals API which produces a re-exportable, idempotent correction record
Automated NetSuite mapping accepts corrected records without schema changes and invoices for a canary org within SLA (24h)
migration_plan: Run enrichment and anomaly detector in shadow mode for 2 weeks across 10% of export traffic. During shadow mode, flagged exports are recorded but not surfaced to Finance. Compare flagged set against historical manual adjustments; compute precision/recall. If metrics meet thresholds (recall >= 0.95 and precision >= 0.6), flip audit queue to active and enable Finance UI access. Backfill: run detector on last 12 weeks and seed the audit queue; Finance will triage in parallel with rollout.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (shadow): 2 weeks on 10% tenants. Phase 2 (pilot): enable flagged export surfacing for Finance on 3 pilot customers and enable approvals API. Phase 3 (gradual): enable audit queue for all tenants over 2 weeks; monitor reprocessing success rate and NetSuite ingest errors. Final step: enable auto-approve for low-risk detections after 6 weeks of pilot with stable metrics.
testing_plan: Unit tests for enrichment fields and idempotent correction records. Integration tests that simulate late meter pulses, overlapping discounts, and coupon application ordering. End-to-end test that walks a flagged export through the approvals API and verifies NetSuite mapping in the staging sandbox. Backfill run validation against known historical corrective exports.
monitoring: Add metrics: flagged_exports.count, flagged_exports.by_reason, approval_latency.histogram, correction_reprocess.success_rate, netsuite_ingest.failures_by_cause. Create Grafana dashboard and PagerDuty alert for netsuite_ingest.failures >5 in 1h during rollout. Add periodic audit job that samples approved corrections and verifies ledger parity with pre-approval snapshot.
